% Regression slice derived from the PGF shapes.multipart manual.
% `rectangle split draw splits` changes only internal separator painting.
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.multipart}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  every node/.style={
    rectangle split,
    rectangle split horizontal,
    rectangle split parts=3,
    rectangle split part fill={blue!20,green!20,orange!20},
    draw,
    inner sep=2pt
  }
]
  \node (drawn) at (0,0) {one\nodepart{two}two\nodepart{three}three};
  \node[rectangle split draw splits=false] (hidden) at (0,-1) {one\nodepart{two}two\nodepart{three}three};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
